Thanks for taking the time in last week's demo. As discussed, I’m kicking off a concise Mutual Action Plan (MAP) for the SOC 2 evaluation and related evaluation plan so we can lock a close timeline. Attached is a first-pass MAP and an evidence checklist (both living).

Quick context: our MAP breaks the work into three lanes — evidence collection (SOC 2 artifacts), evaluation / POC metrics (latency, throughput, privacy fences), and contract/finance close. I’ve proposed owners below — please adjust:

Proposed owners (initial):
- Evidence collection (SOC 2 artifacts): Karthik Iyer (redwood) — primary collector and point for requests

- Customer success / rollout ops: Mina Haddad (redwood) — onboarding checklist and staging

Attachments: MAP-Draft-Aurelia-v1.pdf, SOC2-Evidence-Checklist.xlsx

Next step: Sam/Priya — can you confirm the Aurelia owners and whether the proposed Jul 5–12 handoff window works? If yes, we’ll lock the MAP and create a shared folder for artifacts.

Best,

All — thanks Sam for confirming owners. A couple of operational notes from the infra side:

1) Evidence formats (recommended):
- Network diagrams: PDF + source Visio/Drawio file, labeled with environment tags (prod/staging).
- Access logs: compressed CSV (UTC timestamps) with column headers (user, ip, action, resource, timestamp).
- Config snapshots: YAML or JSON exports where possible (do not include PII).

2) I’ll create a shared folder and an evidence index spreadsheet (read/write) for Aurelia where we’ll track what’s outstanding per artifact. Link to follow.

3) Redwood owners (confirmed):
- Evidence intake & tracking: Karthik Iyer (karthik.iyer@redwood.com)
- Infra evidence & network exports: Vivek Kulkarni (vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com)
- Contract/timeline: Laura Bennett

I’ll aim to upload the index and initial template by EOD today. If Aurelia can provide a first-pass of the high-priority artifacts by Jul 5 we’ll be set to start the evaluation run.

Vivek
Head of Infrastructure, Redwood Inference
